welcome.intro: Build a computer starting from a single NAND gate.
welcome.step1: Each level tells you what the chip you build must do.
welcome.step2: Connect pieces on the canvas and press Test.
welcome.step3: If it passes, the chip joins your palette for the next levels.
welcome.sandbox: In Sandbox you can build anything with what you have unlocked.
welcome.progressText: No account needed. Everything is saved only in this browser. If you clear the site data or switch browser or device, you start over. To take a circuit with you, use Export.

RELAY_NAND.name: Relays
RELAY_NAND.goal: Level 0 (optional): build the NAND with relays. A relay lets its input in through only while its coil c is 1; the inverse one, only while it is 0.
RELAY_NAND.hint: Two relays in series from the source give a AND b; an inverse relay, also from the source, inverts it.

NOT.name: NOT
NOT.goal: Output the opposite of the input: 0 → 1 and 1 → 0.
NOT.hint: NAND gives 0 only when both its inputs are 1.

AND.name: AND
AND.goal: The output is 1 only if a and b are 1.
AND.hint: It is the opposite of a NAND.

OR.name: OR
OR.goal: The output is 1 if a, b or both are 1.
OR.hint: Invert both inputs before a NAND.

XOR.name: XOR
XOR.goal: The output is 1 if a and b differ.
XOR.hint: It can be done with 4 NANDs.

HALF_ADDER.name: Half adder
HALF_ADDER.goal: Add two bits: sum is the result and carry the carry (1 + 1 = 10).

FULL_ADDER.name: Full adder
FULL_ADDER.goal: Add a + b + cin, the carry coming from the previous column.
FULL_ADDER.hint: Two half adders and an OR.

ADDER4.name: 4-bit adder
ADDER4.goal: Add two 4-bit numbers (a3..a0 and b3..b0) plus cin.
ADDER4.hint: Chain the cout of each adder to the cin of the next one.

SR_LATCH.name: SR latch
SR_LATCH.goal: Your first memory. The inputs are active at 0: s=0 stores 1, r=0 stores 0, and with both at 1 it remembers. Q and QB are opposite.
SR_LATCH.hint: Two NANDs that feed each other.

D_LATCH.name: D latch
D_LATCH.goal: While en=1, q copies d; when en=0, q remembers the last value.

D_FLIPFLOP.name: D flip-flop
D_FLIPFLOP.goal: q takes the value of d only when clk rises from 0 to 1.
D_FLIPFLOP.hint: Two D latches: one open with clk=0 and the other with clk=1.
